narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On October 29, 2024, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a strawberry farm near Watervliet, Michigan, during a worksite visit. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and presented a Mexican consular identification card.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that late on 07/04/2020 he climbed through a gap in the border fence east of the San Luis port of entry and walked north for several hours without going through any checkpoint.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Notice to Appear.
